**Peso Pluma's birth name is Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija.**

- Wikipedia says he was born Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija on 15 June 1999 and is known professionally as Peso Pluma: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
- Billboard's artist page, an independent source, gives "real name Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija" and the same 15 June 1999 birthday: https://www.billboard.com/artist/peso-pluma/
- "Kabande" is his surname and "Laija" is his maternal family name, per Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
- His birthplace is reported differently, but no source gave a different name. Wikipedia says Zapopan, Jalisco, and Billboard says the outskirts of Guadalajara: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma and https://www.billboard.com/artist/peso-pluma/

I did not run a dedicated counterevidence search. Search snippets from lower-quality sites (Famous Birthdays, Legit.ng and similar) gave the same name, but I didn't read those pages.
